hunks.baseline: While everyone else was stunned, only two people maintained their composure: Butler Kim and Team Leader Choi, who answered calmly.
hunks.sol: While everyone else stood stunned, only two people remained composed: Butler Kim and Team Leader Choi, who answered calmly.

hunks.baseline: “Time is frightening. I never thought that affectionate little boy would turn out like this.”
hunks.sol: “Time is frightening. Who would have thought that sweet little boy would turn out like this?”

hunks.baseline: “The older I got, the more I began to see things that had been invisible to me before.”
hunks.sol: “The older I got, the more I began to see the things that had once been invisible to me.”

hunks.baseline: “I received a report that you resigned last year. Thinking back on it, I don’t believe I saw your face even once after you joined the Guild. I have to admit, I was a little disappointed.”
hunks.sol: “I received a report that you resigned last year. Come to think of it, I never saw your face even once after you joined the Guild. I must admit, I found that rather disappointing.”

hunks.baseline: His expression showed no disappointment whatsoever, despite his words. Team Leader Choi’s face was no different.
hunks.sol: Despite his words, he didn’t look disappointed in the slightest. Neither did Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: “I felt the same way. If you hadn’t immediately transferred me overseas so I couldn’t even set foot in headquarters, we might have seen each other more often.”
hunks.sol: “I felt the same way. If you hadn’t immediately transferred me overseas and barred me from even setting foot in headquarters, we might have seen each other more often.”

hunks.baseline: “Wasn’t that the picture you wanted, Vice Guild Master?”
hunks.sol: “Wasn’t that exactly what you wanted, Vice Guild Master?”

hunks.baseline: “You think that was what I wanted?”
hunks.sol: “Me?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m sorry to interrupt while you’re speaking.”
hunks.sol: “I’m sorry to interrupt.”

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim, who had remained silent until then, suddenly opened his mouth. His voice was as calm as ever.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim, who had remained silent until then, suddenly spoke. His voice was as calm as ever.

hunks.baseline: “But the young master and I aren’t strangers.”
hunks.sol: “But the Young Master and I are hardly strangers.”

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong widened his eyes in apparent surprise.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong widened his eyes in feigned surprise.

hunks.baseline: It was an exaggerated reaction. If he knew Team Leader Choi, there was no way he could have failed to know Butler Kim, the person closest to him.
hunks.sol: The reaction was clearly exaggerated. If he knew Team Leader Choi, there was no way he wouldn’t know Butler Kim, the person closest to him.

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim did not refuse the hand Lee Jungryong extended. The two men shook hands with even faint smiles on their faces.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim didn’t refuse Lee Jungryong’s outstretched hand. The two men shook hands, each wearing a faint smile.

hunks.baseline: Putting aside exactly what their relationship was, they seemed to be much closer than I had expected.
hunks.sol: Whatever their exact relationship was, they seemed much closer than I’d expected.

hunks.baseline: “When it comes to foul tempers, I’m still several levels below you, Senior. Wouldn’t you agree?”
hunks.sol: “When it comes to a foul temper, you still have me beat by a mile, Senior. Wouldn’t you agree?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi added a word in a chilly voice.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi cut in coldly.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s end this pointless conversation and get to the matter at hand.”

hunks.baseline: How many people in Korea—or in the entire world—could speak so carelessly to Lee Jungryong?
hunks.sol: How many people in Korea—or the entire world—could speak to Lee Jungryong that way?

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong and Song Song were left gaping at the stormy exchange.

hunks.sol: Even I was inwardly astonished by Butler Kim’s behavior, despite having personally witnessed him treat Im Chunsoo, the Guild Master of Sangdong Guild, like a dog several months ago.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was one thing, but even Butler Kim was completely different from his usual self.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t just Team Leader Choi. Even Butler Kim was acting completely unlike his usual self.

hunks.baseline: “One of you is young and hot-tempered, while the other still hasn’t managed to abandon the temper he had in his youth. Well, there’s no harm in getting to the point now, I suppose. It’s a little disappointing, considering I came here as an invited guest.”
hunks.sol: “One of you is young and impatient, while the other still hasn’t shed the temper of his youth. Well, I suppose there’s no harm in getting to the point. Though it is a little disappointing, considering I came here as an invited guest.”

hunks.baseline: “You’re mistaken. Not one of us would invite you, Vice Guild Master.”
hunks.sol: “You’re mistaken. No one here would invite you, Vice Guild Master.”

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong had been looking at the two of them with amusement. Then he suddenly turned his head toward me.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong had been watching the two of them with amusement. Then he suddenly turned toward me.

hunks.baseline: “Didn’t you say it yourself? That I should come in person and apologize to the victim.”
hunks.sol: “Didn’t you say so yourself? That I should come in person and apologize to the victim.”

hunks.baseline: “You have a tendency to speak without considering what comes before or after. Since I accepted your invitation, shouldn’t you start by thanking me?”
hunks.sol: “You have a tendency to say whatever comes to mind without thinking it through. Since I accepted your invitation, shouldn’t you begin by thanking me?”

hunks.baseline: I let out a hollow laugh. The rest of his words were so absurd that they weren’t worth answering.
hunks.sol: I let out a hollow laugh. The rest of his words were so absurd that they weren’t even worth answering.

hunks.baseline: “Your mouth may be crooked, but at least speak straight. It wasn’t an invitation. It was a demand. A demand for an apology.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s get one thing straight. It wasn’t an invitation. It was a demand. A demand for an apology.”

hunks.baseline: “Didn’t you think so yourself? You really didn’t expect me to come.”
hunks.sol: “Didn’t you think so yourself? You never truly expected me to come.”

hunks.baseline: It felt as though someone had dumped a bucket of cold water over me. My words caught in my throat.
hunks.sol: It felt as though someone had dumped a bucket of cold water over me. The words caught in my throat.

hunks.baseline: Though my heart had cried out for anger and revenge, I had never expected Lee Jungryong to come. Even then, my head had coldly compromised with reality.
hunks.sol: Though my heart had cried out for anger and revenge, I had never expected Lee Jungryong to come. Even in the midst of that rage, my mind had coldly compromised with reality.

hunks.baseline: *Lee Jungryong, the man who effectively ruled Ares Guild, was still a giant I couldn’t force to kneel here through my own strength.*
hunks.sol: *Lee Jungryong, the man who effectively ruled Ares Guild, was still a giant I couldn’t force to his knees with my current strength.*

hunks.baseline: “A demand is the right of the strong. Words spoken by the weak to the strong can never be a demand. They are always a request—or an invitation.”
hunks.sol: “A demand is the right of the strong. Words spoken by the weak to the strong can never be demands. They are always requests—or invitations.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s why I came in response to an invitation. No matter what weakness you think you have in your grasp and wave around, that fact will not change. I am Lee Jungryong. I am Ares Guild, and Ares Guild is me.”
hunks.sol: “That’s why I came in response to an invitation. Whatever leverage you think you have over me, that fact will not change. I am Lee Jungryong. I am Ares Guild, and Ares Guild is me.”
At least one thing was clear.

hunks.baseline: At least one thing was clear. Lee Jungryong had not come here to apologize.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong hadn’t come here to apologize.

hunks.baseline: Having etched the overwhelming difference in power into our minds, he continued with a satisfied smile.
hunks.sol: Having driven the overwhelming difference in our power into our minds, he continued with a satisfied smile.

hunks.baseline: “And you shouldn’t treat a guest who came to visit a patient this way. Especially not a guest who brought a present for the patient. Isn’t that right, Team Leader Seok?”
hunks.sol: “And this is no way to treat a guest who came to visit a patient. Especially one who brought a gift for him. Isn’t that right, Team Leader Seok?”

hunks.baseline: The anger I had forgotten began to crawl back up from the depths.
hunks.sol: My dormant anger began crawling back up from the depths.
